title: 目標達成の後に・毎日ボーノ配信☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono wants to garner more fan interest in her races by advertising them during her regular cooking live streams!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that plan in mind, I make my first guest appearance on Umasta Live, and it's a resounding success! People become intrigued by her races, and Hishi Akebono gains more publicity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Things are looking good! We have to keep up the momentum and keep raking in more fans!
